fact: On 3 September 2025 the Director General of the National Bureau of Statistics reported that the Bureau had developed a data sharing and protection protocol, and set up Migration and Health statistics technical working groups, while naming inadequate capacity to generate administrative records for analysis as a challenge.
title: Coordinating the National Statistical System Amidst Fragility
publisher: National Bureau of Statistics, South Sudan (presentation at the UNECA capacity-building workshop, Kiambu)
